metadata.name: Influenza A isolate subtyping and consensus sequence generation (release v0.2)
annotations: This workflow performs subtyping and consensus sequence generation for batches of Illumina PE sequenced Influenza A isolates.

workflow_json.annotation: This workflow performs subtyping and consensus sequence generation for batches of Illumina PE sequenced Influenza A isolates.

data.title: Generate subtyping report from VAPOR output
Set up data structures part 2 - prepare per-segment ID lists for each sample (with fallback empty lists where VAPOR failed)
Compile hybrid reference genome and map reads to it
Build per-sample x per-segment consensus sequences
Get segments suitable for MSA (at least 2 samples have data for the segment) and tree building (data from at least 3 samples)
Set up data structure part 1 - prepare inputs for samples x segments VAPOR runs
